binding_rules.$binding: Substitute the named value captured from an actual prior response, preserving type.
binding_rules.$binding_minus_one: Subtract one from the captured integer; do not change any query/source/run/sample field.
binding_rules.$fixture_bundle: Load exact entry/module bytes from the referenced case's file manifest into an ontokin.bundle/0.1 transport. Manifest filesystem paths are not wire source text.
binding_rules.asynchronous_receipts: Wait for and retain each actual terminal receipt before using its output. Missing/interrupted/unknown outcomes do not become success.
binding_rules.counting: Setup polling/chunk retrieval and read-only evidence collection are real operations and must be logged, but do not create new LP semantic requirement rows.
binding_rules.retry: LP02.06 submits byte-equivalent canonical request LP02.05 with its original request_id. Every other request has a fresh identity.
